name: DuskVerb
purpose: Many reverbs in one: plates, halls, chambers, rooms, spring, gated, reverse and shimmer, each a tuned preset. The choice for lush, spacious, expansive or special-effect reverb.

params.name: Preset
params.ai_hint: The space. Vocals: Vocal Plate, Vintage Vocal Plate, Vocal Hall, 79 Vocal Chamber. Huge: Cathedral Large Hall, Blade Runner 224. Dreamy shimmer: Black Hole, Deep Blue Day.

params.name: Mix
params.ai_hint: Wet amount. 10-20% for a vocal, 25-40% for an obviously wet, expansive sound; shimmer and huge halls need less.

params.name: Decay
params.ai_hint: Multiplies the preset's own tail length. 1.0 is as designed; 0.6-0.8 tightens it for busy mixes, 1.3-2.0 makes it longer and bigger.

params.name: Tone
params.ai_hint: Spectral tilt of the reverb. 0 is as designed; -0.3 to -0.6 darker and smoother (less sibilant splash), +0.3 brighter and airier.

params.name: Character
params.ai_hint: Adds movement and grit to the tail. 0 is clean; 0.2-0.5 gives a more vintage, alive sound.

params.name: Duck
params.ai_hint: Lowers the reverb while the source sounds, so it blooms in the gaps. 0.3-0.6 keeps a big reverb from masking a vocal.

notes: DuskVerb's sounds are its factory presets (each selects an engine and about ninety voicing values plus engine configuration), so the preset is the main control and the other five are layered on top, as in the upstream plug-in.
Other presets: Drum Plate, Vintage Gold Plate, Surf '63 Spring (guitar), Bright Hall, Large Chamber, Small/Medium Drum Room, Live Room, Tiled Room, Ambience, 1981 Gated Snare, Reverse Taps.
Decay is exposed as a multiplier of the preset's decay (clamped to DuskVerb's 0.2-30 s) because each preset is tuned around its own decay time.
Bus mode, freeze and tempo-synced pre-delay are held off: Plugsalot uses it as an insert and does not pass host tempo.

CPU: 5.1% to 10.7% of one core at 48 kHz across two runs on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine with the Vocal Hall preset (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 5 points. Heavier than the Dragonfly reverbs; other presets were not measured individually.
